summary_ja: ALCF APEXの初回projectについて、Aurora CFD、co-evolving knowledge graph、複数open model、domain tool付き分析agentのworkflowを追加しました。実測data量、latency、解析品質、人手削減、energyはCoverage Gapとして残します。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds the inaugural ALCF APEX workflow spanning Aurora CFD, a co-evolving knowledge graph, multiple open models, and an analysis agent with domain tools. Measured data volume, latency, analysis quality, labor reduction, and energy remain coverage gaps. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.timing_ja: APEX初回projectとして2026年6月に開始を公表
items.timing_en: Announced in June 2026 as the inaugural APEX project
items.statement_ja: ALCF APEXの初回projectは、Auroraで乱流・反応流の高忠実度CFDを実行し、simulationとともに更新される知識グラフへ結果を抽象化し、domain toolを備えたLLM分析agentがgraph上の近傍を探索して知見を蓄積する構成です。推論はALCF Inference Service上の複数open-source model backendでsimulationと並行して試す計画で、facility-funded postdocとALCF staff支援も含みます。これは計算量だけでなく、解析待ちを含むtime-to-insightをsystem要件へ入れる事例です。
items.statement_en: The inaugural ALCF APEX project plans to run high-fidelity turbulent and reacting-flow CFD on Aurora, abstract results into a knowledge graph that co-evolves with the simulations, and use an LLM analysis agent with domain tools to traverse graph neighborhoods and accumulate insights. Inference is to run against multiple open-source model backends through the ALCF Inference Service in parallel with simulations, with a facility-funded postdoctoral researcher and ALCF staff support. The case extends system requirements beyond compute time to include analysis delay and time to insight.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIではsimulation、graph構築、推論service、provenance保存を別resourceとして割り当て、end-to-endの完了時間とscientistの確認工数を測れる構成が必要です。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI should be able to allocate simulation, graph construction, inference services, and provenance storage as distinct resources and measure end-to-end completion time and scientist review effort.
adoption_conditions_ja: CFD出力からgraph node・edge・物理量へ変換するschemaとversionを固定する。
simulation、graph更新、retrieval、LLM、domain toolごとの時間、data量、失敗率を記録する。
agentの自然言語出力を、元field、derived quantity、code、parameterへ逆参照できるようにする。
adoption_conditions_en: Version the schema that maps CFD outputs to graph nodes, edges, and physical quantities.
Record time, data volume, and failure rates for simulation, graph update, retrieval, LLM inference, and domain tools separately.
Make each natural-language claim traceable to source fields, derived quantities, code, and parameters.

items.name_ja: 実測data量・latency・解析品質・人手削減は未公表
items.name_en: Measured data volume, latency, analysis quality, and labor reduction are undisclosed
items.statement_ja: 公開資料はworkflow構想と利用可能resourceを示しますが、CFD problem size、出力data量、graph規模、推論request数、model、latency、誤検出・見逃し、expert評価、再現性、人手削減率、追加energyを報告していません。『自然言語で検証可能な知見』という目標も、検証手順と合格基準が必要です。したがって現段階は将来負荷の要求抽出に使い、性能向上の実績とは扱いません。
items.statement_en: The public material describes the workflow concept and available resources but does not report CFD problem size, output volume, graph scale, inference-request count, model, latency, false positives and negatives, expert assessment, reproducibility, labor reduction, or incremental energy. The goal of producing verifiable insight in natural language also needs a verification procedure and acceptance criteria. At this stage, OpenFS uses the project to derive future-workload requirements rather than as evidence of achieved acceleration.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: pilotではFLOPSやsimulation時間に加え、data reduction率、insight precision/recall、根拠追跡成功率、expert review時間、失敗時の復旧をKPIにする必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Pilots should add data-reduction ratio, insight precision and recall, evidence-trace success, expert-review time, and failure recovery to FLOPS and simulation time.
adoption_conditions_ja: 人手解析baselineと同一caseで時間、coverage、誤り、再現性を比較する。
複数modelを同じgraph・tool・prompt・seed条件で評価し、model変更の影響を保存する。
誤った提案がsimulationや実験制御へ波及しないhuman approval gateを設ける。
adoption_conditions_en: Compare time, coverage, errors, and reproducibility with a manual-analysis baseline on the same cases.
Evaluate multiple models under matched graph, tool, prompt, and seed conditions and preserve the effect of model changes.
Use a human-approval gate so incorrect proposals cannot propagate into simulation or experiment control.
